obraGris.definition: The house has its foundation, walls, columns and roof, but no finishes yet: no smooth plaster, paint, floors or fixtures.

escritura.definition: The document signed before a notary that says who owns a property. To be valid against everyone, it must be registered with the Property Institute.

poderNotarial.definition: A document that authorizes someone you trust to sign for you in Honduras. You can get it from the United States at the Honduran consulate.

institutoPropiedad.definition: The Honduran government office where properties are registered. It shows who the owner is and whether the property has debts or liens.

libertadGravamen.definition: A certificate from the Property Institute confirming the property has no mortgages, seizures or other debts.

dominioUtil.definition: A municipal title that gives you the right to use and build on the land. It is common in urban areas and can be converted to full ownership with a legal process.

apartado.definition: A small payment so no one else buys the property while you review the documents and sign the contract. Refund terms are in the refund policy.

pagoInicial.definition: The first payment when you sign the contract. It starts the permits and the design of your home.

cieloFalso.definition: An interior ceiling of drywall or PVC under the roof. It hides wires and pipes and helps keep the house cooler.

varas.definition: The unit many lots in Honduras are advertised in. One square vara is 0.70 m²; one square meter is 1.43 square varas.
